title: KAITO — A Curious Rascal〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Look, Shibao. KAITO came to visit.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Oh, he's wagging his tail...
Does this mean he recognizes me?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That makes me really glad... I wasn't sure he would since I've heard that dogs identify people based on their individual scents...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Thank you for this...
I really appreciate you letting me meet Shibao on such short notice.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, if anything, I'm glad you're here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Like I mentioned in SEKAI, my mom's friend is coming over to our house today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, Shibao needs to stay in your room while they're visiting...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Unfortunately, this person isn't all that fond of animals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I plan to keep him occupied in my room and away from the living room.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm worried that he'll quickly get tired of me and try to escape into the living room...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um, if it's alright with you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Would you mind if I went over to your house that day, Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you so much, KAITO.
It'll be much easier to keep Shibao entertained if you're here with me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <When I came to sit him the other day, I wondered if there were any songs that he liked to listen to...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <So I'm just here to find out by playing some for him.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Did you hear that, Shibao?
KAITO's going to play some songs for you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I played this the last time I was here... I'm guessing he likes these kinds of songs...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much for that, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That was such a fun set.
It had ballads, pop songs, rock and so much more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shibao seemed to as well.
He couldn't help but walk towards you each time you started playing a new song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (He even laid down, stood back up and wagged his tail for one song...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But I'm not sure I played any songs that he really liked...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The third song you played had a very happy and relaxing feel to it. Would you mind playing it again?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I had a feeling...
Look at Shibao's ears, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. They're called airplane ears.
Dogs apparently do this when they're feeling relaxed.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, look at his face. Doesn't he seem a little more mellow than he did for the other songs?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know you're feeling nice and relaxed, but aren't you going to listen to KAITO play?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<It's okay, Honami.
I'm actually a little happy...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (If my performance was able to help him relax and fall asleep...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Then I hope he sees some sweet dreams.)
